message.reasoning:
We need to determine which command saves an Android screenshot as /sdcard/screenshot.png on the device, rather than redirecting it to a file on the host computer.

Two options:

A. adb exec-out screencap -p > screenshot.png

This runs screencap on device, outputs to stdout, then host redirect > screenshot.png, saving to host.

B. adb shell screencap /sdcard/screenshot.png

This runs screencap on device and writes directly to /sdcard/screenshot.png on device.

Thus the correct answer is B.

The answer key says B. Probability of key correctness is 0.95. So likely correct. We should answer with "B".
